items.name: Add Component Menu
items.criteria: Component menu offers available widget/FBD types and creates default geometry.

items.name: Select & Drag Move
items.criteria: Selected widget shows highlight border and moves on drag with grid snapping.

items.name: Resize Handle
items.criteria: Corner handle allows resizing widget dimensions within grid bounds.

items.name: Widget Alignment Tools
items.criteria: Align selected widgets to Left, Right, Top, Bottom, or Center.

items.name: Copy, Cut & Paste
items.criteria: Widget clone retains all properties and extra metadata with offset position.

items.name: Long-press Context Menu
items.criteria: Long press opens context menu for properties, copy, and deletion.

items.name: Multiple Screen Navigation
items.criteria: Navigation across screens retains per-screen widget collections and background colors.

items.name: Static Label / Text (CustomLabel)
items.criteria: Displays custom text with customizable color, background, and font size.

items.name: Button Control (CustomComponents)
items.criteria: Toggleable button state with visual ON/OFF indication and register write-back.

items.name: Two-State Indicator / LED (CustomComponents.q)
items.criteria: Visual LED/indicator reflecting discrete state or live Modbus register value.

items.name: Numeric Setpoint / Adjuster (CustomComponents.i)
items.criteria: Adjustable setpoint with +/- controls, numerical display, and register write-back.

items.name: Dynamic Text (CustomDynText)
items.criteria: Multi-state text updating text and background color based on live register value.

items.name: Analog Gauge / Scale (CustomComponents.m)
items.criteria: Visual scale/gauge rendering scaled process values.

items.name: Progress Bar (CustomComponents.v)
items.criteria: Horizontal progress bar displaying percentage or scaled value.

items.name: Trend / Chart View (CustomComponents.o)
items.criteria: Graph view displaying historical data points over time.

items.name: Bit List Widget (CustomList)
items.criteria: Displays bit state indicators driven by live Modbus register mask.

items.name: Boolean Logic (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR)
items.criteria: Full logical evaluation of combined inputs.

items.name: Flip-Flops (RS, SR)
items.criteria: Bistable set/reset logic latches with state memory and state recovery.

items.name: Edge Triggers (R_TRIG, F_TRIG)
items.criteria: Detect rising or falling signal edges across evaluation scans.

items.name: Timers (TON, TOF, TP)
items.criteria: On-delay, off-delay, and pulse timing logic in milliseconds with state recovery.

items.name: Counters (CTU, CTD)
items.criteria: Up and down counting with configurable preset limit, reset, and state recovery.

items.name: Comparisons (<, <=, >, >=, ==, !=)
items.criteria: Numerical comparison of two input values or constants.

items.name: Math & Selection (+, -, *, /, ABS, MIN, MAX, MOVE, SEL)
items.criteria: Basic arithmetic calculations, division-by-zero safety, and signal selection blocks.

items.name: Inter-block Wiring & Cycle Prevention
items.criteria: Visual wire rendering between blocks with cycle detection rejecting feedback loops.

items.name: JSON Project Save/Load
items.criteria: Full serialization of screens, widgets, geometries, and FBD connections.

items.name: Metadata Preservation (deepCopy)
items.criteria: Unknown or extra JSON metadata preserved across round-trip edits.

items.name: ZIP Project Export/Import
items.criteria: ZIP archive packaging TableNameProject JSON and assets safely.

items.name: Archive Security Validation
items.criteria: Rejection of traversal paths, duplicate file entries, and oversized files.

items.name: Atomic Write Persistence
items.criteria: Atomic project file save preventing file corruption during unexpected termination.

items.name: Modbus TCP FC03 & FC04
items.criteria: Polling of Holding (FC03) and Input (FC04) registers using 0-based protocol indexing.

items.name: Modbus TCP FC06 & FC16 Writes
items.criteria: Writing single (FC06) and multiple (FC16) registers for bound controls and FBD outputs.

items.name: Modbus RTU Transport & CRC16
items.criteria: Correct CRC16 calculations and stream transport helper for serial/RTU communication.

items.name: Exception & Timeout Reporting
items.criteria: Detailed diagnostic error strings for timeouts, socket failures, and Modbus exceptions.
